summary: Frontend-only QA completed on public preview URL for login, scanner, and verified pages. Core requested flows pass (validation, navigation, localStorage persistence, theme persistence, offline/online simulation, manual and hardware scan flows, empty/restore list, and overflow checks).

integration_issues.issue: A forced rapid second click was accepted by automation on confirm button, but ticket persistence still resulted in a single record (no duplicate).

action_items: Optional hardening: guard confirm handler against repeated forced clicks at event layer (idempotency lock around confirm action).
Optional: ignore or suppress non-app telemetry request failure log (/cdn-cgi/rum net::ERR_ABORTED) if noisy for QA logs.
critical_code_review_comments: All critical interactive controls already expose data-testid attributes and key flows are wired correctly.
Theme and verified ticket storage are consistently managed via localStorage keys in app.js.
No hardcoded backend dependency or build-chain coupling detected; static prototype constraints are respected.
test_credentials: File checked: /app/memory/test_credentials.md is present but empty; no credentials required for this static prototype flow.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data files created. Verified list data changed only through app localStorage flows during test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Main regression run used public URL https://qr-gate-check-3.preview.emergentagent.com. Confirmed no horizontal overflow at 1920x800 and 390x844. Follow-up run failed once on retry selector due transient script state, while same flow passed in primary run.
rca of the issue: Potential double-click concern appears limited to force-click automation behavior. UI logic disables confirm immediately (setButtonLoading), and save path de-duplicates by code before storage, preventing duplicate ticket records in observed run.
